missions.title: Hackpad
missions.description: Design your own mini keyboard from scratch, get all the parts for free! Check out the guide at https://hackpad.hackclub.com/guide

missions.title: Make a Slack Bot
missions.description: Make a slack bot that can respond to custom slash commands!
requirements: Your bot is live and responds to messages
There are at least 3 different commands / functions
Your commands don’t collide with anyone elses’
Your bot is live 24/7, even when your laptop is closed

missions.title: WebOS 1
missions.description: Make your very own OS that can be run in the web! This is a beginner friendly workshop based around making your own web page. Follow the guide and make it your own to complete this mission and unlock WebOS 2, where you can customize it further!
requirements: Have a working webpage with multiple draggable windows
It should look like your own and not exactly like the guide
Have at least 3 devlogs showing your progress along the way
Have at least 1 new feature that the guide didn’t list
It shouldn’t have a password (so anyone can test it out!)
prizes: 50 stardust Yours to spend in the shop!
WebOS Sticker An exclusive sticker for completing the WebOS 1 mission!
Unlocks WebOS 2 Completing this mission will unlock the WebOS 2 mission

missions.title: WebOS 2
missions.description: Customize your WebOS further to make it your own! Make the theme fully custom, add your own apps, and do anything else to make it feel unique. (to do this mission, complete WebOS 1 first!)
requirements: at least 3 new features from what you submitted to WebOS 1
prizes: WebOS Stickersheet! An incredible exclusive stickersheet you can get just from the WebOS 2 mission!
